title: 第54章 是什么影响你的判断？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

冯野平静的话就像一记惊雷轰下。

司陇震惊地看着对方的眼睛，可她看到的只有冯野坚定不移的眼神。

她的视线落在了桌上那张线人最新情报图上，图片中朱山正穿梭于一个小巷中，而他身后裹着皮大衣的女人，正是孟梵！

虽然没有正脸，但那走路的姿态和身形，就是没有变幻形态的孟梵本人无疑。

真的是孟梵带走了朱山。

不是冯野。

司陇的心脏砰砰地跳动着，她视线又重回冯野身上，只见对方没有再注意自己，只是微闭着眼睛，疲惫地揉着太阳穴。

重伤加上失血过多，让冯野原本就白皙的皮肤此刻看上去更是清透如纸，在这台灯的冷光映射下显得鬼魅非凡。

冯野提到老杨的时候，为什么她能够如此冷静？

冷静的就好像这个猜测她已经怀疑很久了。

就像司陇之前分析的那样，只有内部人才能知晓老杨的定位，那老杨自爆定位确实也是有可能的。

孟梵变幻成冯野，伪装成冯野的模样语气提走了朱山，这是基于孟梵本身就对冯野有所了解，但在老杨这种十分熟悉冯野的人面前，能够完全骗过的成功率也并非百分之一百。

可孟梵就是成功骗过了老杨，带走了朱山。

老杨，确实有嫌疑。

但也还有一种可能，冯野在转移视线，故意把矛头指向老杨。

想到这司陇决定，把该问的都问清楚。

“最后搜查朱山住处时，我找到了一份黎明署B线的线人名单。”说到这的时候，她顿了顿，紧接着又说道，“那名单上有你的名字，而你的代号记录是，B。”

冯野睁开微微闭着的眼睛，有些疑惑地看向司陇，并没有立刻回应。

她从刚刚批复过的文件里又抽出一沓，仔细地翻阅着，很快就看完了。

看完后冯野才把视野重新挪回到司陇身上，与她对视后认真地说道，“我又检查了一遍徐科长提交的案件记录，物证里面并没有你所说的，黎明署B线线人名单。”

冯野推了推眼镜，缓缓地说道，“你没交出来？”

额......

司陇一下又愣住了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Feng Ye's calm words were like a thunderbolt.

Si Long looked into the other person's eyes in shock, but all she saw was Feng Ye's unwavering eyes.

Her eyes fell on the latest intelligence picture of the informant on the table. In the picture, Zhu Shan was walking through an alley, and the woman wrapped in a fur coat behind him was none other than Meng Fan!

Although there is no frontal face, the walking posture and body shape are undoubtedly Meng Fan himself without changing form.

It was really Meng Fan who took Zhu Shan away.

Not Feng Ye.

Si Long's heart was beating loudly, and her eyes returned to Feng Ye. She saw that the other party no longer paid attention to her, but closed his eyes slightly and rubbed his temples tiredly.

Severe injuries and excessive blood loss made Feng Ye's originally fair skin look as clear as paper at the moment, looking ghostly under the cold light of the lamp.

Why was Feng Ye so calm when she mentioned Lao Yang?

Calmly, it was as if she had doubted this guess for a long time.

Just like Si Long's previous analysis, only insiders can know Lao Yang's positioning, so it is indeed possible for Lao Yang to self-destruct his positioning.

Meng Fan transformed into Feng Ye and pretended to be Feng Ye and mentioned Zhu Shan away. This was because Meng Fan knew something about Feng Ye, but in front of someone like Lao Yang who was very familiar with Feng Ye, the success rate of being able to completely deceive him was not 100%.

But Meng Fan successfully deceived Lao Yang and took Zhu Shan away.

Lao Yang, there is indeed a suspicion.

But there is also a possibility that Feng Ye is diverting his attention and deliberately pointing the finger at Lao Yang.

Thinking of this, Si Long decided to ask everything clearly.

"When I finally searched Zhu Shan's residence, I found a list of informants from Line B of the Dawn Department." When she said this, she paused, and then said, "Your name is on that list, and your codename record is, B."

Feng Ye opened his slightly closed eyes and looked at Si Long with some confusion, but did not respond immediately.

She took out another stack of documents she had just approved, flipped through them carefully, and quickly finished them.

After reading it, Feng Ye turned his attention back to Si Long, looked at her and said seriously, "I checked the case records submitted by Section Chief Xu again. The physical evidence does not contain the list of B-line informants of the Dawn Department as you mentioned."

Feng Ye pushed up his glasses and said slowly, "You didn't hand it over?"

Um...

Si Long was stunned again.
